name: appbase-monorepo
description: AppBase Core and the apps built on it. Each package keeps its own dependencies.

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix packages/core && node scripts/apps.mjs setup
scripts.check: npm run starter:check && npm run core:check && npm run apps:check
scripts.check:affected: npm run starter:check && node scripts/test-affected-apps.mjs && node scripts/apps.mjs affected
